description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the LeaveRequestService component in the OrangeHRM leave module. It contains unit tests verifying methods related to leave request statuses, detailed retrieval of leave requests, and workflow permissions. The class extends a custom TestCase and includes mock setup for dependencies such as DAOs and workflow managers.

classes.name: LeaveRequestServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class verifying the behaviors of LeaveRequestService methods, including status retrieval, detailed leave request processing, and workflow permission logic.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestDao
methods.description: Tests that getLeaveRequestDao returns an instance of LeaveRequestDao.

methods.name: testGetAllLeaveStatusesAssoc
methods.description: Verifies that getAllLeaveStatusesAssoc returns a proper mapping of status IDs to names.

methods.name: testGetLeaveStatusNameByStatus
methods.description: Checks that getLeaveStatusNameByStatus returns the correct name or throws an exception for invalid status.

methods.name: testGetLeaveStatusByName
methods.description: Verifies fetching status ID by status name or exception on invalid name.

methods.name: testGetLeaveStatusesByNames
methods.description: Validates retrieving multiple status IDs from an array of names, exception on invalid input.

methods.name: testGetDetailedLeaveRequests
methods.description: Tests retrieval and correct ordering of detailed leave request data with associated leaves.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestAllowedWorkflows
methods.description: Checks retrieval of allowed workflow actions for a given employee, leave type, and status.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestAllowedWorkflowsWithDeletedLeaveType
methods.description: Verifies workflow permission retrieval when the leave type is marked as deleted.

methods.name: getMockWorkflowActions
methods.description: Helper to generate mock workflow actions for testing permissions.

methods.name: testGetDetailedLeaves
methods.description: Verifies correct grouping and ordering of leaves under detailed leave request objects.
